text: At this moment the model does not identify any single change that would automatically turn the decision around. However, you can still work on strengthening your overall credit profile. Focus on building a longer, positive credit history by keeping existing accounts open and using them responsibly. Pay down outstanding balances so that the portion of credit you’re using stays well below your limits—ideally under 30 % of each line. Avoid opening many new accounts at once, and make sure any new credit you do take on is paid on time. Over time, these habits can raise your score and improve the chances of approval in future applications.
